name: playwright
description: Take screenshots and interact with web pages using a headed Playwright browser. Use when you need to visually inspect a URL, capture a screenshot, interact with a page (click, type, scroll), or verify what a page looks like rendered. **Triggers — use this skill when:** - You need to screenshot a URL (Penpot share link, localhost, public site) - User says "show me", "how does it look", "take a screenshot" - You want to visually verify your own work (e.g. after creating Penpot designs) - User asks to review a live page or prototype - You need to interact with a page (click buttons, fill forms, trigger states)
